errors.evidence: This describes the end point of the orange line (Latvia). However, the orange line ends at coordinates (68.9, 72.3) according to the chart labels. errors.text_span: Третата линия е синя, съставена от кръгли маркери, свързани с плътна линия. Тя започва около точка (30, 40) и завършва в точка (80, 81,6), като преминава през връх около (50, 72,3)
errors.evidence: Multiple errors in this sentence. The blue line (Estonia) ends at (83.2, 79.6), not (80, 81.6); the point (81.6, 66.5) is the end point for the grey line (Lithuania). The point with y-coordinate 72.3 is on the orange line (Latvia) at x=68.9, not on the blue line.

This describes the starting point of the grey line. Visually, the grey line starts at approximately (32, 28). The stated Y-value of 33 is significantly incorrect, as the point is visibly below the y=30 gridline.
This describes the end point of the grey line (Lithuania). While the Y-coordinate 66.5 is correct, the X-coordinate is explicitly labeled on the chart as 81.6, not 80.
